title: Unknown Modbus Error analogue with stateful unregister path
purpose: Introduce explicit session-state interaction by pairing RegisterSession with UnregisterSession, improving lifecycle coverage and handle propagation diversity beyond single-frame requests.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse a RegisterSession request followed by a valid UnregisterSession frame carrying a nonzero session handle; if the handle is recognized, the session may be torn down, otherwise an encapsulation-status error may be returned by the implementation.
constraints_preserved: 24-byte EtherNet/IP encapsulation header used for both messages
Commands 0x0065 RegisterSession and 0x0066 UnregisterSession taken from supplied command catalog
State relationship preserved by reusing a nonzero session handle in the second message
UnregisterSession carries zero-length payload as a conservative analogue
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no vulnerability claim. The chosen session handle is a benign placeholder for stateful corpus growth and not a replay of any historical issue payload.
